hook.name: FlashPerpsV5Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps on registered USDC/perpetual-token pools through a FlashPerpsV5Issuer, intercepting fills via beforeSwapReturnsDelta to mint or redeem perpetual position tokens. An AMM curve (QuantCurve) serves as a backstop for partial issuer fills, and bounded upkeep is executed in afterSwap when sufficient gas is available.
